description: Stage replacement discards the replaced stage’s local feature declarations.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes = A
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
%redefine-stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ¬f? A
```
